title: Redraw Camera Ease Without Jump
description: After board redraw play stops: no end camera jump; 1s hold then 2s ease-in-out zoom to graph bbox; do not abort ease on fixture churn during suppress; fix timer clearing in effect 2140.
summary: Post-redraw camera: 1s hold + 2s ease unchanged; easing uses ease-in-out cubic (slow–fast–slow). Effect that depended on fixture no longer clears hold/RAF while suppressCameraBasisSyncRef is true, so progressive fixture churn cannot abort the ease. Animation ends by applying blend(t=1), then clearing override on the next rAF so derived cameras match. Default play cameras are bbox-centered fit for all panes (replacing triptych offsets) so the ease target matches post-ease derived state—no end jump. Settings blurb updated.
